erasmus.oneLineEn: Classical learning and The Praise of Folly advance inward evangelical piety and limited free will via satire.

machiavelli.oneLineEn: Detaches political judgment from moral preaching, explaining power and liberty through virtù and republican conflict.

montaigne.oneLineEn: Essayistic self-writing turns doubt into temperate living and trains judgment under the awareness of death.

bacon.oneLineEn: Clears cognitive bias via the four idols; ordered induction and experiment make knowledge a discovery procedure.

hobbes.oneLineEn: Equal vulnerability and distrust yield the state of nature; covenant and concentrated sovereignty purchase peace.

descartes.oneLineEn: Methodic doubt secures the certainty of the cogito and mind-body dualism underwrites clear scientific knowledge.

spinoza.oneLineEn: Substance monism of God-or-Nature uses geometric method to show the necessity of the affects and of freedom.

locke.oneLineEn: Empirical theory of ideas rejects innate ideas; consent and natural rights constrain governmental power.

leibniz.oneLineEn: Windowless monads and pre-established harmony explain individual substances; sufficient reason accounts for world order.

hume.oneLineEn: Reduces causation to constant conjunction and habit; rebuilds morals by sentiment and sympathy and probes religion.

rousseau.oneLineEn: The natural-man hypothesis critiques civilized inequality; general will and popular sovereignty rewrite legitimacy.

hegel.oneLineEn: Negation and recognition drive consciousness's history; freedom is realized as institutional ethical life as a whole.

schopenhauer.oneLineEn: Blind will explains the world's essence and suffering; aesthetic contemplation and compassion offer paths of release.
keywordsEn: The World as Will and Representation

kierkegaard.oneLineEn: Aesthetic, ethical, and religious stages force individual choice; faith stands outside ethical universality.

mill.oneLineEn: The harm principle defends personal liberty and joins higher pleasures and representative government to utilitarianism.

marx.oneLineEn: Explains consciousness from production relations; commodity fetishism and surplus value expose capitalist exploitation.

nietzsche.oneLineEn: Genealogy probes the origin of morals; after the death of God, will to power and perspective revalue all values.

frege.oneLineEn: Rebuilds logic via function-argument and sense/reference, advancing a logical foundation for arithmetic.

husserl.oneLineEn: Intentionality and phenomenological reduction examine how consciousness appears; the life-world grounds the sciences.

bergson.oneLineEn: Duration resists spatialized time; intuition grasps life's creativity and the spiritual depth of memory.

wittgenstein.oneLineEn: Early picture theory bounds the sayable; later language-games and use treat philosophical confusions.

heidegger.oneLineEn: Dasein analysis reopens the question of Being; being-in-the-world and being-toward-death open authentic possibility.

russell.oneLineEn: Logical analysis and the theory of descriptions clarify knowledge; fallibilism restrains superstitious faith in power.

whitehead.oneLineEn: Actual occasions and prehension replace substance; process philosophy corrects the fallacy of misplaced concreteness.

carnap.oneLineEn: Recasts traditional disputes as choices among linguistic frameworks; logical syntax clears pseudo-problems.

arendt.oneLineEn: Action and natality define political freedom and show how totalitarianism destroys the common world and judgment.

sartre.oneLineEn: Existence precedes essence; freedom as for-itself nothingness and the Other's gaze is inescapable responsibility.

beauvoir.oneLineEn: Woman is the Other produced by history; she asks how concrete freedom is realized within a given situation.

merleau-ponty.oneLineEn: Body schema and perceptual field rewrite the subject; meaning arises in embodied expression intertwined with the world.

camus.oneLineEn: Defines the absurd as demand for meaning meeting the world's silence; limited revolt refuses new forms of oppression.

foucault.oneLineEn: Genealogy shows knowledge-power co-forms the subject; discipline and techniques of the self map modern governmentality.

derrida.oneLineEn: Différance and iterable writing unsettle presence-metaphysics; deconstruction enters justice and responsibility.

habermas.oneLineEn: Communicative reason resists system colonization; public discourse rebuilds democratic legitimacy and the life-world.
